soak.error: failed to open index: failed to fill whole buffer

diagnosis.root_cause: reader raced the append-only .delta log while the writer had exposed only a prefix of the newest variable-length record
diagnosis.why_error_matched: read_delta_record accepted UnexpectedEof only when reading the first opcode byte. UnexpectedEof in flags/ids/name-length/name bytes propagated as the raw std::io error 'failed to fill whole buffer'.
diagnosis.correctness_model: a partial final delta record is an uncommitted append/crash tail, not a corrupt committed record; complete records before it remain valid and the partial tail must be ignored until a later refresh sees it complete
current_fix: make every field read in read_delta_record tail-tolerant for UnexpectedEof
keep fully-readable invalid op/name length/UTF-8 fail-closed
add deterministic partial fixed-header and partial filename-tail regressions
